Question ID: JOUR_U05_L05_GP_Q01

MLA Standard: MLA.JOUR.REP.05

Source: Friday Broadcast Package Workflow. Project: The newsroom must publish a two-minute Friday broadcast package about the school supply drive. Deadline: Final package must be submitted by Thursday at 3:30 p.m. for Friday morning release. Team Tasks: Reporter drafts the script, video editor cuts interview clips, photo editor adds two accurate still images, copy editor checks names and captions, and producer exports the final file. Current Status: The interview clips are recorded, but one student name needs spelling confirmation. The script is missing a transition between the donation total and the volunteer quote.
